# Groviadigi

> Groviadigi is a business automation and custom software studio based in Ajmer, Rajasthan, India. It builds custom CRMs, internal tools and dashboards, workflow automations and business websites for small and growing companies in India and abroad. Tagline: "Your Vision. Our Development."

## Services
- Custom CRM development: lead management, follow-up reminders, quotations, payments, built around the client's own sales steps.
- Workflow and business process automation: form to CRM, sheet to email, WhatsApp alerts, scheduled reports, app integrations. People stay in the loop where judgement matters.
- Internal tools: portals, request and approval flows, master databases, live dashboards.
- Business websites: designed, written and built from scratch, fast and ready for search.
- Care plans: monthly maintenance, fixes, updates and small improvements.

## Starter offer: Missed Follow-up Fix
- One automation that reads an existing Excel, Google Sheet or Zoho and sends the sales team WhatsApp reminders when a lead is due, plus a daily owner summary.
- Live in 10 working days. Fixed price ₹19,999 (₹14,999 for the first 5 clients, until 31 Jan 2027).
- Money back if the team is not using it after 30 days. Fee credited against a custom CRM within 60 days.
- Custom CRM from ₹90,000 (3 milestone payments). Care plans from ₹5,000 a month.

## How Groviadigi works
1. Free 15-minute discovery call, then a consultation to map the current process.
2. Written scope, timeline and fixed quote before work starts.
3. Development and testing with real data; nothing goes live without client review.
4. Deployment, handover with training and documentation, optional monthly maintenance.

## Positioning
Groviadigi first asks whether automation is needed at all. The recommendation can be to improve the process, automate key steps, or automate end to end.

## Proof
- Smart Sun Power (rooftop solar installer): custom solar CRM covering leads, site surveys, quotations, installations and payments. Lead conversion rose 28% within three months of go-live. Delivered by Digiink Solutions, now part of Groviadigi.
